introduction: Follow eight independent captive rescues, gather eight cut bindings for Beregan, and deliver three exact invader hands to Jandar. Side quests include the monkey, neckchain, badge and dog. All seventeen exchanges are explained; availability gaps are explicit. Active, ready accounting is mandatory for new journal, achievement and daily credit.
orientation: This is the invaded Desolate zone 773, distinct from normal Desolate zone 222. Discovery and receipts remain independently owned. The initially closed zone is opened by normal Desolate’s random-exit object 22291 at exterior 22200, which can redirect the north route to 77302 and its south return. Source reset chance 20 percent and callback chance 100 percent are different; the live phase and current route need qualification.

Loud orc, goblin and Shady Grove orc start at campground 77358; old and Pinehollow loggers at cabin 77381; monkey hunter at command post 77342; monk and cleric at temple 77435. Each consumes one actual shard and returns bindings, then departs. Beregan in bar backroom 77421 accepts eight current bindings together. His claim that citizens are free is narration, not a check of eight distinct personal rescues.

Shard sources include hidden container stock in garbage 77360 and trapped weapon pile 77457, and nomadic merchant 77408 at 77432. Repeated reset lines retain shared caps and do not guarantee fresh stock. No-exit room 77465 is explicitly a shard-load check room; it is not a player recovery destination. Normal Desolate items do not substitute.

The hunter’s monkey-return exchange and shard rescue are independent. Return the monkey before retiring the hunter if you want both. The monkey is a closed item container in bear den 77394; its hidden neckchain is minotaur proof. Remove the chain before consuming the monkey so the nested item is not lost with the container.

Minotaur 77327 starts at garbage pile 77360 and rewards bronze key 77311. It unlocks the fixed chest there, which holds money, trophy and brass bracelet. Jandar 77319 at master chamber 77370 needs severed hands 77373, 77385 and 77392 from Gromlog 77342, Alboa 77382 and Mackama 77375. These are authored inventory/equipment items, not a CARVE controller. The rewarded black-gate key 77384 fits the paired locked gate at 77343/77361.

Myrabolus delegate and Beregan start at 77421. The scout badge is equipped at 77352; the dog starts at 77428 and wants hidden stinky bones from garbage 77360. NORENT on bones and both reward keys remains intact. Cut bindings require two hands if used as equipment, but are not transient items.

Halfling 77325, wagon driver 77348 and travelling merchant 77380 have no identified local reset. The halfling asks for blade 77331 despite drink narration. Driver wheel 77352 has no identified producer; placed Scotson has no repair recipe here. Keep these builder gaps visible without promising stock or reusing normal Desolate contracts.

The nomadic shop at 77432 lists shard 77326, deep blue potion 77356 and scroll 77388. A stock declaration is not a settled purchase or proof of renewal. The separate travelling merchant’s coin-only quest purchase is guarded under active accounting and earns no story/daily credit. Bank counter 3097 binds storage-locker ENTER service; paid lockers are guarded. Actual inn assignment is tunnel 77442, while 77422’s inn prose says closed; do not assume a functioning tavern service or move the binding.

The hidden Master trial’s PUSH route is chamber 77410 east to Sacrifice 77411, east to Endurance 77412, south to Art 77413, west to Courage 77414, west to Affinity 77415, then north to 77410. Knighthood 77416 branches above Sacrifice. Buttons clear existing blocked exits; current combat guardians and dragon loot are not a completed-trial receipt. Endurance and Courage’s direction captions now match their existing south/west buttons.

Branches at 77386 PULL west; torch at 77364 PULL down and black soil at 77365 PUSH up; barricades at 77453/77454 PUSH down/up. Secret and closed state is separate from clearing BLOCKED. Unplaced rock controls target missing west/east exits and require builder intent. Seven fixed portals retain their existing enter restrictions and return routes; fall fields are risks, not guaranteed quest arrival.

No captured universal first-source, source-versus-gift, control, personal kill, phase episode or full-zone victory fact is invented. Historical accepted exchange rows remain optional, while current exact material and settled terminal outcomes stay separate. Mode2 renewal, actor retirement, hidden sources, shop stock and active accounting’s item-reset refusal still need played qualification before these sixteen potential dailies can be promised.
